scope: Role-aware attendance copy, checkout timing lock, attendance state machine, skill XP/levels, availability blocks + recommendations, backend status note. Mock-only localStorage Next.js 16 MVP, no backend.

details.reason: Fix requires a Next.js major downgrade. Build-time CSS tooling, not an app runtime input path. Carried over from CS6/CS7/CS8; no deps added by CS9.

findings.observation: XP is never a form field. awardSkillXp runs inside confirmCompletion (store action), so a worker cannot inflate level via UI. Client-side localStorage editing remains the universal mock limitation; backend plan makes XP server-computed.
findings.test: src/__tests__/coreStability9.test.ts (awardSkillXp create/accumulate/disputed); code review of confirmCompletion

findings.observation: scheduleStore.update/remove enforce OWNER_MISMATCH; the schedule page reads forUser(currentUserId). A worker cannot read or mutate another worker's availability/busy blocks.
findings.test: existing scheduleStore owner-guard coverage; code review

findings.observation: suggestShiftsForWorker runs client-side over the signed-in worker's own blocks + the public shift list; surfaces no other user's data. Conflicting shifts drop out of the ranking.

findings.area: XSS in availability notes / skill labels
findings.observation: Block titles/notes and skill category labels render as escaped React text (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML). Match-label pills come from a fixed Vietnamese vocabulary, not user input.

Attendance state is a pure projection (deriveAttendanceState); canCheckOut enforces worker self check-in + the [end, end+60min] window in the store, so direct route navigation or UI tampering cannot unlock check-out early or fabricate presence. Employer mark-present cannot stamp worker checkInAt.
findings.test: src/__tests__/coreStability9.test.ts (checkout boundary; employer-only never unlocks); coreStability8.test.ts (mark-present != checkInAt)

findings.observation: Attendance copy is keyed by viewer role; the employer surface never renders worker-addressed strings and vice-versa.

knownLimitations: Mock-only: all authorization is client-side; a user can edit localStorage via devtools. Real server-side authz (server-computed skill XP, availability RLS) is the Phase 1 backend deliverable (backend-migration-plan.md §7, §11).
Clearing browser storage loses all runtime data — now disclosed site-wide in the footer (Part 6).
